notes: To check first: (1) Heligoland (items 570, 571, 585, 830): you listed Heligoland as an example of a place, but stations.json has a 'heligoland' station, so I used the station. Change it if you meant a place. Malmo, Stevns, Northrepps and Great Cotes are also matched to their 'other' stations, even in years they aren't listed. (2) Teesmouth vs Redcar: 'Teesmouth', 'Teesmouth (Redcar)' and 'the mouth of the Tees' go to teesmouth-1880, which is only listed in 1880. 'Redcar' (about 270 observations across items) is a place, as you said. These are probably the same land observer, so pick one. The 1879 'the Teesmouth' went to tees-lv; item 1261 mixes years and should be split. (3) How I read the garbled type words: u.u./uu/t.u./u.H./u.n./u.a./u.x./u.z. = L.H.; u.v./t.v./L.v./Ly./LvV. = L.V. This only matters for Hasbro', which has both a lighthouse and a light-vessel (items 554, 557, 560, 562 and 563 are the judgement calls). Where a station has no light-vessel (Farne, Coquet, Cromer, Whitby, Hunstanton, Hanois), an L.V. reading is treated as the lighthouse. (4) 'Farn' and 'Farne Islands' go to inner-farne, which the lists print as 'Farn Islands'. Range uses like 'the Farne Islands' (1490) could mean both Farne lights; 'Farns', 'two Farn Island lighthouses' and 'Farn Island stations' are given as both. (5) Low-confidence guesses: 1029 'Resin L.v.' as Dowsing; 307 'Dowsing u.v.' and 971 'Outer' as Outer Dowsing; 814 'Longstone lighthouses' as Longstone plus Inner Farne; 160 'Breakwater' as South Gare; 1260 'Tees-mouth' 1886 as the light-vessel plus South Gare. (6) Unresolved and marked none: 1249 'TE L.H.', 1474 'seettie', 1530 '= mouth'. These need the source page. (7) Place calls worth a look: 377 read as Fårö (Sweden), not Faroe; 191 Buxby = Buxey Sand; 117 Beesby; 192 Cadeby near Grainsby; 1343 Whitley Sands; 872 and 1229 Kent Stour or Harwich Stour; 118 printed as Beccles (Norfolk), but Beccles is in Suffolk. (8) Group phrases ('East Coast stations', 'stations off the Essex and Kent coasts', 'stations between the Farn Islands and Yarmouth') are given as coastal places rather than expanded into station lists.
